ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A named configuration that binds a trigger type, a set of conditions, and an ordered list of actions. The engine loads enabled rules matching an incoming trigger and evaluates them.
An external event that initiates the evaluation of matching AutomationRules. Identified by a TriggerType and carries contextual payload in a TriggerContext.
usageExamples: TriggerType.DELIVERABLE_APPROVED fires when a client_portal deliverable is approved

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A single boolean test applied to a TriggerContext field using a ConditionOperator. An AutomationRule passes only when all of its Conditions evaluate to true.
A side-effect to be dispatched as a Django-Q2 task when an AutomationRule passes evaluation. Each Action has an ActionType and a parameters dict consumed by its ActionHandler.
A single execution record for an AutomationRule triggered by a specific event. Tracks the status lifecycle from pending through a terminal state (success, failure, or dry_run).
An immutable log entry appended to an AutomationRun. Records the outcome of each condition evaluation step and each action dispatch attempt.
usageExamples: AutomationRunLog(run_id=run.id, message='Email sent to stakeholder', level='info', logged_at=now())
Expandable log entries rendered in the /automations/:id/runs page

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: An immutable value object carrying the payload of a trigger event. Passed to RuleEvaluationService for condition evaluation and forwarded to ActionHandlers for parameterization.
An execution mode where an AutomationRule is fully evaluated (all conditions checked) but no Actions are dispatched as Q2 tasks. Results are logged and the Run reaches RunStatus.DRY_RUN.

A decorator-based dictionary mapping TriggerType, ConditionOperator, and ActionType string keys to their handler callables. Allows new trigger types and action types to be registered without modifying the core engine.
usageExamples: registry.py - canonical location for all registry decorators

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A ConditionOperator value that defines how a Condition compares a TriggerContext field value against an expected value.
usageExamples: ConditionOperator.GT - field value must be greater than expected_value
ConditionOperator.CONTAINS - field value must contain expected_value as a substring or list element

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A callable registered in the Registry that performs the side-effect for a given ActionType. Executed as a Django-Q2 task and writes its outcome to an AutomationRunLog.
usageExamples: create_activity_event_handler(parameters, context) - appends to client_portal ActivityEvent log

entities.name: AutomationRule
invariants: name must not be blank
trigger_type must be a valid TriggerType value
An enabled rule must have at least one AutomationAction
All AutomationAction.order values within a rule must be unique
conditions and actions are never null; empty list is valid for disabled rules

stateTransitions.guard: rule has at least one AutomationAction configured

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate identity; UUID v4 assigned at creation

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable rule name; must not be blank

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional long-form description of the rule purpose

attributes.name: is_enabled
attributes.description: Whether the engine will evaluate this rule on matching triggers

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: The trigger category that activates this rule

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: Ordered list of conditions; all must pass for the rule to fire

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Ordered list of actions to dispatch when the rule passes evaluation

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of rule creation

entities.name: AutomationCondition
invariants: field_name must not be blank
expected_value must not be blank
operator must be a valid ConditionOperator value
rule_id must reference an existing AutomationRule

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate identity; UUID v4

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Identity of the owning AutomationRule

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator applied to the extracted field value

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: Dot-path key used to extract a value from the TriggerContext payload

attributes.name: expected_value
attributes.description: The comparison target; coerced to the field type at evaluation time

entities.name: AutomationAction
invariants: action_type must be a valid ActionType value
parameters must not be None; empty dict is valid
order must be >= 0
rule_id must reference an existing AutomationRule

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate identity; UUID v4

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Identity of the owning AutomationRule

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The category of side-effect this action dispatches

attributes.name: parameters
attributes.description: Action-type-specific configuration dict; validated by the ActionHandler at dispatch time

attributes.name: order
attributes.description: Execution sequence within the rule; lower values execute first

entities.name: AutomationRun
invariants: rule_id must reference an existing AutomationRule
triggered_at must not be in the future
completed_at must be >= triggered_at when set
error_message must be set when status is FAILURE
status transitions must follow the defined lifecycle

stateTransitions.guard: status is PENDING and is_dry_run is False
status is RUNNING and error_message is not blank
is_dry_run is True and status is PENDING

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate identity; UUID v4

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Identity of the AutomationRule that was executed

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: TriggerType string value that fired this run

attributes.name: triggered_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the trigger was received by the engine

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the run

attributes.name: is_dry_run
attributes.description: True when actions are not dispatched; conditions are evaluated and all steps logged

attributes.name: completed_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the run reached a terminal status; None while running

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: First unrecoverable error; set when status is FAILURE

entities.name: AutomationRunLog
invariants: run_id must reference an existing AutomationRun
message must not be blank
level must be one of: info, warning, error
logged_at must not be in the future

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate identity; UUID v4

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Identity of the owning AutomationRun

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the log event

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Log severity: info, warning, or error

attributes.name: logged_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this entry was appended

valueObjects.name: TriggerType
validationRules: value must be one of: deliverable.approved, metric.threshold_crossed, invoice.overdue, file.uploaded

valueObjects.name: ConditionOperator
validationRules: value must be one of: gt, lt, eq, contains, assigned_to

valueObjects.name: ActionType
validationRules: value must be one of: send_email, create_activity_event, update_status, send_sms

valueObjects.name: RunStatus
validationRules: value must be one of: pending, running, success, failure, dry_run

valueObjects.name: TriggerContext
validationRules: trigger_type must be a valid TriggerType value
payload must not be None; empty dict is valid

aggregates.name: AutomationRuleAggregate
invariants: An enabled AutomationRule must have at least one AutomationAction
AutomationCondition and AutomationAction instances must not outlive their owning AutomationRule
All AutomationAction.order values within a rule must be unique
AutomationConditions and AutomationActions are only accessible through the AutomationRule root

aggregates.name: AutomationRunAggregate
invariants: AutomationRunLog entries are append-only and must never be deleted or mutated
AutomationRunLog instances are only accessible through the AutomationRun root
AutomationRun.status must follow the defined lifecycle: PENDING -> RUNNING -> SUCCESS|FAILURE, or PENDING -> DRY_RUN
error_message is required when status is FAILURE

domainEvents.name: AutomationRuleCreated
domainEvents.trigger: A new AutomationRule is persisted for the first time via the CreateAutomationRule use case

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the newly created rule
Name of the newly created rule
TriggerType value of the new rule
UTC timestamp of creation

domainEvents.name: AutomationRuleEnabled
domainEvents.trigger: AutomationRule.enable() is called on a rule where is_enabled is False

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the rule that was enabled
UTC timestamp of the transition

domainEvents.name: AutomationRuleDisabled
domainEvents.trigger: AutomationRule.disable() is called on a rule where is_enabled is True

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the rule that was disabled
UTC timestamp of the transition

domainEvents.name: AutomationRunStarted
domainEvents.trigger: AutomationRun.start() is called; the engine begins action dispatch

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the run that started
Identity of the rule being executed
TriggerType string that fired this run
Whether this run is in dry-run mode
UTC timestamp when the run started

domainEvents.name: AutomationRunCompleted
domainEvents.trigger: AutomationRun.complete() or AutomationRun.mark_dry_run_complete() is called after all actions are dispatched successfully

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the completed run
Identity of the rule that was executed
Terminal RunStatus value: success or dry_run
UTC timestamp of completion

domainEvents.name: AutomationRunFailed
domainEvents.trigger: AutomationRun.fail(error_message) is called after an unrecoverable action dispatch error

payload.description: Unique event identity
Identity of the failed run
Identity of the rule that failed
First unrecoverable error that caused the failure
UTC timestamp of failure

methods.name: find_by_id
methods.description: Return the AutomationRule with the given identity, or None if not found. Hydrates the full conditions and actions collections.

methods.name: find_by_trigger_type
methods.description: Return all AutomationRules (enabled and disabled) matching the given TriggerType. Used by the engine to discover candidate rules for evaluation.

methods.name: find_all_enabled
methods.description: Return all AutomationRules where is_enabled is True. Used for admin listing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist or update an AutomationRule together with its full conditions and actions collections. Upserts child records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove the AutomationRule and cascade-delete all owned AutomationConditions and AutomationActions.

methods.name: find_by_id
methods.description: Return the AutomationRun with the given identity including its RunLog entries, or None if not found.

methods.name: find_by_rule_id
methods.description: Return all AutomationRuns for the given rule ordered by triggered_at descending. Used by the run history view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist or update an AutomationRun. Appends any new RunLog entries; existing entries are never modified (append-only).

domainServices.name: RuleEvaluationService
domainServices.responsibility: Evaluates all AutomationConditions of an AutomationRule against a TriggerContext. Returns True only when every condition passes. Stateless; contains no I/O or repository access.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluate every AutomationCondition on the rule against the TriggerContext payload using the ConditionOperator. Returns True if all conditions pass, False if any condition fails. Raises ValueError for unknown ConditionOperator values.

domainServices.name: AutomationEngineService
domainServices.responsibility: Orchestrates the full rule execution lifecycle: load the rule via AutomationRuleRepository, evaluate conditions via RuleEvaluationService, create and persist an AutomationRun, dispatch each AutomationAction as a Django-Q2 async_task (skipped in dry-run mode), append RunLog entries for each step, and transition the run to SUCCESS, FAILURE, or DRY_RUN.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Load the AutomationRule by ID, evaluate conditions against the TriggerContext, create an AutomationRun record, dispatch each passing AutomationAction as async_task, append a RunLog entry per action, and transition the run to SUCCESS or FAILURE based on overall outcome.

methods.name: execute_dry_run
methods.description: Same as execute but with is_dry_run=True. Evaluates conditions and logs what actions would fire without dispatching any Django-Q2 task. Transitions the run to DRY_RUN status and returns the log entries.
